tree.heading: General rule
tree.text: In the case of an individual, gross income includes unemployment compensation.

tree.heading: Unemployment compensation defined
tree.text: For purposes of this section, the term “unemployment compensation” means any amount received under a law of the United States or of a State which is in the nature of unemployment compensation.

children.heading: In general
children.text: In the case of any taxable year beginning in 2020, if the adjusted gross income of the taxpayer for such taxable year is less than $150,000, the gross income of such taxpayer shall not include so much of the unemployment compensation received by such taxpayer (or, in the case of a joint return, received by each spouse) as does not exceed $10,200.
